title: Smart Data Models - BudgetLine, an extension of dataModel.CPSV-AP/Cost
description: One line of a city budget in the national budget classification, with the approved and the adjusted amount. Extends dataModel.CPSV-AP/Cost: CPSV-AP Cost is the official model of an amount a public body sets (identifier, value, currency); no subject holds a budget line.
$comment: allOf: dataModel.CPSV-AP/Cost's schema.json at commit a05d1663475fc0f79361bc9bc2550c3f24df1ba0 with its type set to BudgetLine, then the attributes the extension adds (T-4336). Generated by scripts/open-data/generate.py.

type.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. It has to be Cost

identifier.description: Property. Model:'dct:identifier'. This property represents an Identifier for the Cost. This property should be a URI if it is modelled in RDF

value.description: Property. Model:'cv:value'. This property represents a numeric value indicating the amount of the Cost

currency.description: Property. Model:'cv:currency'. This property represents the currency in which the Cost needs to be paid and the value of the Cost is expressed. The possible values for this property are described in a controlled vocabulary. The recommended controlled vocabularies are listed in the European Publications Office's Currencies Named Authority List (NAL), following the ISO 4217 (https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/dataset/-/resource?uri=http://publications.europa.eu/resource/dataset/currency)

description.description: Property. Model:'dct:description'. This property represents a free text description of the Cost

isDefinedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'cv:isDefinedBy'. This property links the Cost class with one or more instances of the Public Organization class. This property indicates which Public Organization is the Competent Authority for defining the costs associated with the delivery of a particular Public Service

ifAccessedThrough.description: Relationship. Model:'cv:ifAccessedThrough'. Range:'Channel'. Where the cost varies depending on the channel used, for example, if accessed through an online service cf. accessed at a physical location, the cost can be linked to the channel using the If Accessed Through property

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be BudgetLine

adjustedAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The amount after the year's budget changes so far, in the same unit as the approved one.

approvedAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The amount the council approved, as the city publishes it. The city's documentation names no unit; the 2026 expenditure lines add up to 119 054 085, which is the size of Prague's budget in thousands of CZK.

budgetArea.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. The city's own area of the line (oblast), its code and name joined, such as 09 Školství; absent on a correction line the city files under none.

budgetFunction.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. The section of the national budget classification (paragraf, ODPA), code and name.

budgetItem.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. The item of the national budget classification (položka), code and name. Items 1xxx to 4xxx are revenue, 5xxx and 6xxx expenditure, 8xxx financing.

budgetPurpose.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. The earmark of the line (účelový znak), code and name.
